scripts.name: Bye-bye (drbyebye)
scripts.description: The Professor E. Gadd lab farewell demo (dodb.szp, the archive's own name is drbyebye): Gadd, Luigi with the flashlight and the Poltergust in the lab set, played by the same demo machinery as the opening. Blend-shape weight tracks (.slk) and texture flipbooks (.txp) are not yet decoded, so faces hold their rest shape.
